answer: Emission weight is set by measured accuracy on planted relic items, not by tenure or bond size. Each epoch the protocol escrows known-answer items whose grade is already sealed, and they are indistinguishable from live work. A farm that rubber-stamps everything misses the flawed sable and falls below the 0.6 posterior threshold, which zeroes its influence and forfeits its staked holdback until it recovers. Buying more identities means more canaries to pass, so a lazy onyx scores lower, not higher, and its collateral is slashed on ejection.
